quest_oldman_000.title: Talk to the Old Man
quest_oldman_000.summary: Find the Old Man in his cozy wood cabin.
quest_oldman_000.objective: Talk to the Old Man in his cabin.
quest_oldman_000.nextStep: Go to the cabin (Room 003) and speak with the Old Man. His cabin is to the southwest of the Grassy Field Crossroads.
quest_oldman_000.reminderDialog: You haven't met the Old Man yet. Head to his cabin (Room 003), southwest of the Grassy Field Crossroads, and introduce yourself.
quest_oldman_000.completionDialog: Hey! Another Wanderer! I love having you guys around. An old man like me could always use a hand. First, can you bring me a flower.

quest_oldman_001.title: A Flower for my Wife
quest_oldman_001.summary: The Old Man sure is romantic. Help him pick a flower for his wife.
quest_oldman_001.objective: Bring a Yellow Flower to the Old Man.
quest_oldman_001.nextStep: Find a Yellow Flower in the flower patch to the north, then return to the Old Man in Room his cabin.
quest_oldman_001.reminderDialog: Have you found that yellow flower yet? You can find them in the flower patch to the north. Just bring me one when you have it!
quest_oldman_001.completionDialog: A yellow flower! Perfect! My wife loved flowers, I will put this on her grave later tonight.

quest_youngsoldier_000.title: Talk to the Young Soldier
quest_youngsoldier_000.objective: Talk to the Young Soldier east of here.
quest_youngsoldier_000.nextStep: Go to the Traning Area in the Grassy Field and talk to the Young Soldier.
quest_youngsoldier_000.reminderDialog: The Young Soldier is waiting impatiently.
quest_youngsoldier_000.completionDialog: I can't believe we're really giving experience for just talking to me.

quest_youngsoldier_001.title: Equip a Weapon
quest_youngsoldier_001.summary: The soldier insists you should arm yourself.
quest_youngsoldier_001.objective: Equip any weapon in your Main Hand.
quest_youngsoldier_001.nextStep: Open Inventory and equip something into Main Hand.
quest_youngsoldier_001.reminderDialog: This is so easy. Just pick up and equip a weapon. Open your INV and equip a weapon in your Main Hand, the higher the STR the better.
quest_youngsoldier_001.completionDialog: Wow, you can pick up a sword. I can't believe we're giving XP for this.

quest_youngsoldier_002.title: Collect the Scorpion Tails
quest_youngsoldier_002.summary: The Young Soldier needs Scorpion Tails to prove you can handle the creatures beyond the beach.
quest_youngsoldier_002.objective: Collect 5 Scorpion Tails for the Young Soldier.
quest_youngsoldier_002.nextStep: Hunt Scorpions for their tails, gather 5 of them, then return to the Young Soldier.
quest_youngsoldier_002.reminderDialog: Still short on tails? Bring me 5 Scorpion Tails and I'll know you're ready.
quest_youngsoldier_002.completionDialog: Very well Wanderer. You're no longer just an adventurer with a weapon, you're one who knows how to use it. I think you're ready to explore this world."

quest_jacklumber_intro.title: Talk to Jack Lumber
quest_jacklumber_intro.summary: A lumberjack lives north of the Forest Gate. He might have work for a proven Wanderer.
quest_jacklumber_intro.objective: Open the Gold Chest and talk to Jack Lumber in his cabin.
quest_jacklumber_intro.nextStep: Use the Gold Key to open the Gold Chest at the Grassy Field Crossroads, then head northwest to Jack Lumber's cabin and speak with him.
quest_jacklumber_intro.reminderDialog: You found me! But before we get to work, you should go open that gold chest back at the Crossroads. Come back after you've cracked it open.
quest_jacklumber_intro.completionDialog: Ha! You cracked the chest! I knew you had it in you. I'm Jack Lumber — get it? Like Lumberjack! Listen, I've got some work that needs doing around here, and you look like just the Wanderer for the job.

quest_jacklumber_000.title: The Chief's Cloak
quest_jacklumber_000.summary: Jack Lumber wants the Goblin Chief's cloak. Wearing it lets you walk past the Goblin Titan without getting torn apart.
quest_jacklumber_000.objective: Defeat the Goblin Chief in the Bat Cave and bring his cloak to Jack Lumber.
quest_jacklumber_000.nextStep: Head into the Bat Cave, hunt down the Goblin Chief, take his cloak, then bring it back to Jack in his cabin north of the Forest Gate.
quest_jacklumber_000.reminderDialog: Still no cloak? The Goblin Chief's hiding somewhere deep in the Bat Cave. Go find him, take the cloak off his back, and bring it here. Simple as chopping a tree!
quest_jacklumber_000.completionDialog: Well I'll be! You actually got it! With that cloak the Goblin Titan won't give you trouble on the way through. The Forest Path east of here is all yours now, Wanderer. Go see what's out there.

quest_jacklumber_001.title: Boomerang Some Bats
quest_jacklumber_001.summary: Jack says the Bat Cave is crawling with bats. Bring him their wings and he'll make it worth your while.
quest_jacklumber_001.objective: Collect 5 Bat Wings from the Bat Cave.
quest_jacklumber_001.nextStep: Head into the Bat Cave south of the Stone Path and hunt bats for their wings. Bats fly, so you'll need a ranged weapon like a boomerang or bow to hit them. Bring 5 Bat Wings back to Jack.
quest_jacklumber_001.reminderDialog: Only got {progress} of {count} wings so far? Remember, bats fly — you need a ranged weapon to hit them. Equip your boomerang or craft a bow and get back in there!
quest_jacklumber_001.completionDialog: Five wings, nice haul! Here's a little something for your feet. And remember — any enemy that flies is out of reach of a sword. Always keep a ranged weapon handy for those.

quest_jacklumber_002.title: Jack's Woodworking Lesson
quest_jacklumber_002.summary: Jack offers to teach you the basics of woodworking. Chop some wood and craft a Wooden Bow at his workshop.
quest_jacklumber_002.objective: Craft a Wooden Bow at Jack's workshop.
quest_jacklumber_002.nextStep: Pick up the hatchet at Jack's cabin, head north to the Tree Farm to chop wood, then come back to Jack's cabin and use the crafting table to craft a Wooden Bow.
quest_jacklumber_002.reminderDialog: Still working on that bow? Grab the hatchet here if you haven't, chop some trees up north at the farm, then use my crafting table to put a bow together. Easy!
quest_jacklumber_002.completionDialog: Now THAT is a proper bow! You've got the basics of woodworking down. Keep the bow — it'll serve you well against those flying critters. Here's some materials to get you started on your next project.

quest_youngsoldier_003.title: Training Armor Pro
quest_youngsoldier_003.summary: The Young Soldier says a true recruit earns their full set of training armor by hunting the creatures that carry each piece.
quest_youngsoldier_003.objective: Collect all 4 pieces of training armor: Helmet, Armor, Gloves, and Boots.
quest_youngsoldier_003.nextStep: Defeat a Sand Crab for the Training Helmet, a Gator for the Training Armor, a Spider for the Training Gloves, and a Scorpion for the Training Boots. Then return to the Young Soldier.
quest_youngsoldier_003.reminderDialog: Still missing some gear? Each beast drops one piece: the Sand Crab carries the Helmet, the Gator the Armor, the Spider the Gloves, and the Scorpion the Boots. Come back once you've got all four.
quest_youngsoldier_003.completionDialog: Now THAT is a proper recruit. Full kit, head to toe. You wear it well, Wanderer.

quest_oldman_002.title: Rat Problem
quest_oldman_002.summary: The Old Man's basement has been overrun with giant rats. He needs someone brave enough to deal with them.
quest_oldman_002.objective: Defeat 2 Giant Rats in the Cabin Basement.
quest_oldman_002.nextStep: Head down into the Cabin Basement and defeat 2 Giant Rats, then return to the Old Man.
quest_oldman_002.reminderDialog: I got so many rats down there. Go on down and take out two of the giant ones, not the little ones.
quest_oldman_002.completionDialog: Excellent! Rats ain't got nothing on you. Now it's time to deal with the gator.

quest_oldman_003.title: The Gator
quest_oldman_003.summary: With the rats cleared out, the Old Man turns his attention to a bigger problem — a massive gator lurking in the marsh behind his cabin.
quest_oldman_003.objective: Defeat the Gator in the Marsh behind the cabin.
quest_oldman_003.nextStep: Head southwest into the Marsh and defeat the Gator, then return to the Old Man.
quest_oldman_003.reminderDialog: That gator is still out there in the swamp. Head southwest into the marsh and deal with it when you're ready.
quest_oldman_003.completionDialog: Nice work Wanderer! NEXT QUEST INFO GOES HERE

quest_oldman_004.title: Blueberry Jam
quest_oldman_004.summary: The Old Man has a craving for his wife's famous blueberry jam. He needs a good haul of fresh blueberries.
quest_oldman_004.objective: Bring 10 Blueberries to the Old Man.
quest_oldman_004.nextStep: Gather 10 Blueberries from the blueberry patch, then return to the Old Man.
quest_oldman_004.reminderDialog: The Old Man leans back with a wistful look. "My wife makes the most wonderful blueberry jam, but we're fresh out of berries. Head over to the blueberry patch and bring me back ten of 'em when you get a chance."
quest_oldman_004.completionDialog: The Old Man's eyes go wide. "Well I'll be — you actually got 'em! Those'll make the finest jam this side of the bayou. My wife is going to be absolutely delighted, I tell you."

quest_freddie_intro.title: Talk to Freddie
quest_freddie_intro.summary: A cow farm and leather workshop sits just off the Forest Path. The man who runs it charges for the hides and gives away the hammers.
quest_freddie_intro.objective: Talk to Freddie at his Cow Farm.
quest_freddie_intro.nextStep: Take the Forest Path east from the Grassy Field, then north at the cow farm sign (Room 103), and introduce yourself to Freddie.
quest_freddie_intro.reminderDialog: You haven't met Freddie yet. His cow farm is north off the Forest Path, the first turning after you leave the Grassy Field.
quest_freddie_intro.completionDialog: Freddie wipes his hands on his apron. "Let's craft with some leather. You can use my cows to gather some — but you have to pay!" He nudges a crate of hammers toward you with his boot. "Those are free, at least."

quest_freddie_001.title: Craft with Leather
quest_freddie_001.summary: Freddie's hides are the first material you can turn into real armour. He wants to see you make something out of one.
quest_freddie_001.objective: Craft any piece of leather equipment.
quest_freddie_001.nextStep: Take a free hammer from Freddie, pay his 50 gold toll and gather leather from the cows to the north (5 a trip). Then find a crafting table — the Old Man's cabin, Jack Lumber's cabin or the Shaman's tent — and craft a leather hood, gloves or boots for 3 leather apiece.
quest_freddie_001.reminderDialog: "Still nothing to show me? Hammer's in the crate, hides are through the gate, and any crafting table will do. Three leather makes a hood."
quest_freddie_001.completionDialog: Freddie turns the piece over twice and hands it back. "That'll hold. Come get hides whenever you like — and if you want more than five at a go, hunt them in the forest." He loads you up with supplies on the way out.

quest_forestgnome_intro.title: Talk to the Forest Gnome
quest_forestgnome_intro.summary: A gnome keeps a cozy tree hut deep in the Forest. He has work for a Wanderer — and a spare hatchet.
quest_forestgnome_intro.objective: Talk to the Forest Gnome at his tree hut.
quest_forestgnome_intro.nextStep: Find the Forest Gnome's tree hut (Room 128), deep in the Forest — northwest of the Forest by a Cliff — and introduce yourself.
quest_forestgnome_intro.reminderDialog: You haven't met the Forest Gnome yet. His tree hut sits among the branches deep in the Forest — go and say hello.
quest_forestgnome_intro.completionDialog: The gnome peers down at you from the branches with a lazy grin. "Welcome to my tree hut. Pretty nice right?" He hops down. "Since you're here — I've got a few things that need doing, and you look like you've got the legs for it."

quest_forestgnome_001.title: Gnome Needs Berries
quest_forestgnome_001.summary: The Forest Gnome wants berries — twenty red and twenty blue. He is not saying what for.
quest_forestgnome_001.objective: Bring 20 Redberries and 20 Blueberries to the Forest Gnome.
quest_forestgnome_001.nextStep: Pick berries from the bushes scattered around the Forest — redberries by the river, the small graveyard and the abandoned campsite; blueberries at the forest dead end and atop the hill. Plenty of enemies drop them too.
quest_forestgnome_001.reminderDialog: "Still short on berries? They grow all over this forest — red ones down by the river and the graveyard, blue ones at the dead end and up on the hill. Twenty of each, that's all I ask."
quest_forestgnome_001.completionDialog: "Twenty and twenty, just like I asked!" The gnome takes the whole lot, smashes it together on the spot, and hands you back an armful of potions. "Waste not!"

quest_forestgnome_002.title: New Tree Hut Door
quest_forestgnome_002.summary: The Forest Gnome's tree hut needs a new door. Twenty pieces of wood should cover it.
quest_forestgnome_002.objective: Bring 20 Wood to the Forest Gnome.
quest_forestgnome_002.nextStep: Chop trees anywhere in the Forest with a hatchet — there's a spare one here at the tree hut if you need one — then bring 20 wood back.
quest_forestgnome_002.reminderDialog: "Only {progress} of {count} wood so far? Take a hatchet — there's a spare one right here — and chop the trees around this forest. Twenty pieces and I can finally build that door."
quest_forestgnome_002.completionDialog: "Twenty pieces! That's a door and then some." The gnome passes you a coil of leather and an iron hatchet. "Keep that one. It bites deeper than yours — you'll bring back twice the wood from every tree."

quest_forestgnome_000.title: Troll Base Camp
quest_forestgnome_000.summary: Trolls hold the camp at the north end of the Forest, guarding the way to the Dark Forest. The gnome wants three of them gone.
quest_forestgnome_000.nextStep: The Troll Base Camp lies at the far north of the Forest. Defeat 3 Trolls there, then return to the tree hut.
quest_forestgnome_000.reminderDialog: "Only {progress} of {count} trolls down? They're camped up north, guarding the gate to the Dark Forest. Three of them, then come see me."
quest_forestgnome_000.completionDialog: "Three trolls! Ha!" The gnome tosses you a fresh pair of gloves. "Made these myself. Troll hide — still warm."

quest_hunterbill_intro.title: Talk to Hunter Bill
quest_hunterbill_intro.summary: A hunter keeps a camp under the canopy near the Forest entrance. He tracks everything that moves out here.
quest_hunterbill_intro.objective: Talk to Hunter Bill at his camp.
quest_hunterbill_intro.nextStep: Find Hunter Bill's camp (Room 118), north through the Forest Entrance and past the massive tree, and introduce yourself.
quest_hunterbill_intro.reminderDialog: You haven't met Hunter Bill yet. His camp sits under the canopy near the Forest entrance — go and say hello.
quest_hunterbill_intro.completionDialog: A wiry man looks up from a half-strung bow and grins. "Yo! I just love being in nature." He nods at the trees. "Stick around a while. There's things out there worth hunting, and I'll make it worth your trouble."

quest_hunterbill_001.title: Bigfoot Sighting
quest_hunterbill_001.summary: Bigfoot is rarely seen — some say he doesn't exist at all. Bill says otherwise, and he wants proof.
quest_hunterbill_001.nextStep: Bigfoot turns up anywhere in the Forest, but only rarely. Keep hunting until he shows himself, then return to Bill's camp.
quest_hunterbill_001.reminderDialog: "No Bigfoot yet? He's out there. Doesn't matter which part of the forest — keep walking it and he'll turn up eventually."
quest_hunterbill_001.completionDialog: Bill lets out a low whistle. "You actually found him." He drags a heavy fur cloak out of his tent. "Made this from the last one. Been waiting for somebody who'd earned it."

quest_hunterbill_000.title: Forest Hunter
quest_hunterbill_000.summary: The forest animals are running rampant. Bill wants one of each taken down — and he'll part with a Gold Key for it.
quest_hunterbill_000.objective: Hunt a Wild Boar, Wolf, Coyote, Buck, Bear and Stag.
quest_hunterbill_000.nextStep: All six roam the Forest. Travel it until each one crosses your path, then return to Bill's camp.
quest_hunterbill_000.reminderDialog: "Still got some hunting left. Wild Boar, Wolf, Coyote, Buck, Bear, Stag — one of each, and they're all in this forest somewhere."
quest_hunterbill_000.completionDialog: "All six." Bill hands over a light, worn shield, then a heavy gold key. "That key opens the gold chest northeast of here. Best gear in the forest is sitting in it."

quest_redguardcaptain_intro.title: Talk to the Red Guard Captain
quest_redguardcaptain_intro.summary: The Captain runs Red Town's security from the lookout tower above the Barracks. He is not short of work.
quest_redguardcaptain_intro.objective: Talk to the Red Guard Captain at the Forest Lookout.
quest_redguardcaptain_intro.nextStep: Head north from the Grand Square to the Warrior's Way, on to the Red Guard Barracks, then northeast through the Captain's office and up to the Lookout Tower (Room 215).
quest_redguardcaptain_intro.reminderDialog: You haven't met the Red Guard Captain yet. He keeps watch from the Lookout Tower above the Barracks, north of the Grand Square.
quest_redguardcaptain_intro.completionDialog: The Captain does not turn around. "Finally. I need your help cleaning up this town." He gestures out over the treetops without looking at you. "Three jobs. Take them in any order."

quest_redguardcaptain_001.title: Bring 3 Thieves to Justice
quest_redguardcaptain_001.summary: Thieves work the roads and back alleys around Red Town. The Captain wants three of them dealt with.
quest_redguardcaptain_001.nextStep: Thieves turn up anywhere in Red Town and along the stone paths — more often in the back alleys and the sewers. Take down three, then return to the Lookout Tower.
quest_redguardcaptain_001.reminderDialog: "{progress} of {count} so far. They're out there — walk the roads and the alleys and they'll find you soon enough."
quest_redguardcaptain_001.completionDialog: "Three fewer." The Captain finally turns round and hands you a crossbow, then two heavy quivers. "Take these. You'll want the reach."

quest_redguardcaptain_002.title: Swords for the Red Guard
quest_redguardcaptain_002.summary: The Red Guard is short on blades. Five long swords will do.
quest_redguardcaptain_002.objective: Bring 5 Long Swords to the Red Guard Captain.
quest_redguardcaptain_002.nextStep: Alpha Scorpions, Orcs, Kobolds and Tarantulas drop Long Swords. Adam's General Store and Michael's Weapon Shop both sell them if you'd rather save the time.
quest_redguardcaptain_002.reminderDialog: "{progress} of {count} swords. Buy them from Adam or Michael, or take them off an Alpha Scorpion, Orc, Kobold or Tarantula — I don't much mind which."
quest_redguardcaptain_002.completionDialog: "Five. That'll arm the night watch." He pulls an officer's helm off the rack and puts it in your hands. "Elite issue. Don't lose it."

quest_redguardcaptain_003.title: Sewer Pest Control
quest_redguardcaptain_003.summary: The sewers under town are infested with mutated vermin. The Captain wants a sample of each exterminated.
quest_redguardcaptain_003.objective: Defeat a Tarantula, a Sewer Rat and a Red Gator.
quest_redguardcaptain_003.nextStep: The sewer entrances are in the Red Town Courtyard and in the back alley east of Wizards Way. All three live down there.
quest_redguardcaptain_003.reminderDialog: "Still crawling down there. A Tarantula, a Sewer Rat and a Red Gator — one of each and I'll call it done."
quest_redguardcaptain_003.completionDialog: "One of each. The sewers are a slightly less awful place." He hands over a flail with three spiked heads. "Found it down there years ago. It suits you better than it ever suited me."

quest_townhallplaza_intro.title: Talk to the People at the Plaza
quest_townhallplaza_intro.summary: The Town Hall Plaza is full of citizens taking care of business — and several of them are offering rewards for help.
quest_townhallplaza_intro.objective: Talk to the people at the Town Hall Plaza.
quest_townhallplaza_intro.nextStep: The Plaza (Room 221) is northeast of the Red Town Courtyard. Go and hear what the people there need.
quest_townhallplaza_intro.reminderDialog: You haven't spoken to anyone at the Plaza yet. It's northeast of the Red Town Courtyard.
quest_townhallplaza_intro.completionDialog: You barely make it three steps in. "Help us! Please!" A gardener, a chef and a couple with a crying child all start talking at once.

quest_townhallplaza_001.title: Twice as Nice
quest_townhallplaza_001.summary: The Plaza gardener wants a matched pair of flowers, and is oddly particular about where the second one comes from.
quest_townhallplaza_001.objective: Bring 2 Flowers to the Town Hall Plaza.
quest_townhallplaza_001.nextStep: Pick one in the Grassy Field flower patch, then pick the second from the Babylon Gardens — west of the Mayor's office, up from the Plaza.
quest_townhallplaza_001.reminderDialog: "Only {progress} of {count} flowers. One grows out in the Grassy Field, and you can pick the other right here in the Babylon Gardens."
quest_townhallplaza_001.completionDialog: "Two! A matched pair!" The gardener is far more pleased than two flowers warrant, and presses a crate of potions on you — wings and gills both. "For the places flowers don't grow."

quest_townhallplaza_002.title: Cookin up some Meat-a-balls
quest_townhallplaza_002.summary: The Plaza chef needs cooked meat, and will teach you what he does with it.
quest_townhallplaza_002.objective: Bring 5 Cooked Meat to the Town Hall Plaza.
quest_townhallplaza_002.nextStep: Many creatures drop raw meat. Cook it over any fire at a crafting table — there's one right in the Grand Square — and bring five cooked pieces back.
quest_townhallplaza_002.reminderDialog: "{progress} of {count} pieces! Cook the raw meat over a fire, eh? There's a good one in the Grand Square."
quest_townhallplaza_002.completionDialog: "Bellissimo!" The chef takes the meat and walks you through it start to finish. You leave with five meatballs and the recipe in your head. They restore 400 HP a piece.

quest_townhallplaza_003.title: Stolen Teddy Bear
quest_townhallplaza_003.summary: A little girl is crying in her parents' arms. Thieves took her teddy bear down into the sewers.
quest_townhallplaza_003.nextStep: The Master Thief holds the Thieve's Den treasure room. Get into the sewers, find the false wall at the dead end — or the secret entrance off the back alley — and work your way in.
quest_townhallplaza_003.reminderDialog: "The Master Thief still has it. He's down in the Den, past the training room. Please — she hasn't slept."
quest_townhallplaza_003.completionDialog: Little Suzie cheers when you hand over the stuffed animal, and will not let go of it again. Her parents press what they have on you — a ring off the father's hand and two jars of good balm. "It isn't much. She hasn't slept in a week."

quest_mayorrudolf_intro.title: Talk to the Mayor
quest_mayorrudolf_intro.summary: Mayor Rudolf runs Red Town from the top floor of Town Hall. He has been waiting for someone capable.
quest_mayorrudolf_intro.objective: Talk to Mayor Rudolf in the Town Hall Office.
quest_mayorrudolf_intro.nextStep: The Mayor's office (Room 222) is north of the Town Hall Plaza.
quest_mayorrudolf_intro.reminderDialog: You haven't met the Mayor yet. His office is at the top of Town Hall, north of the Plaza.
quest_mayorrudolf_intro.completionDialog: The Mayor puts down his pen. "The Scorpion King has brought fear to this town for far too long." He slides a bounty notice across the desk. "Name your price when it's done."

quest_mayorrudolf_000.title: Scorpion King Bounty
quest_mayorrudolf_000.summary: The Mayor is offering the largest bounty in Red Town's history for the Scorpion King's head.
quest_mayorrudolf_000.nextStep: The Scorpion King holds the throne room at the end of the lair below the Grassy Field Spider Cave. A lever down there opens the secret passage to him.
quest_mayorrudolf_000.reminderDialog: "The Scorpion King still sits down there. His lair runs below the Spider Cave, out in the Grassy Field. Find the lever, find the passage, finish it."
quest_mayorrudolf_000.completionDialog: "It's done." The Mayor counts out a sum that takes both hands, then adds a red stone talisman and a heavy gold key. "That key opens the chest in the Babylon Gardens. West of this office, and down. You've earned whatever is in it."

quest_warriorsguild_intro.title: Talk to the Warrior's Guild Recruiter
quest_warriorsguild_intro.summary: Sword and axe wielding warriors congregate outside the guild's massive stone hall. One of them is clearly recruiting.
quest_warriorsguild_intro.objective: Talk to the Warrior's Guild Recruiter.
quest_warriorsguild_intro.nextStep: The Warrior's Guild (Room 226) is northwest of the Grand Square.
quest_warriorsguild_intro.reminderDialog: You haven't spoken to the Warrior's Guild Recruiter yet. The guild is northwest of the Grand Square.
quest_warriorsguild_intro.completionDialog: The recruiter looks you up and down without much hurry. "Slay the Ogre Lieutenant and prove you're a true Warrior. Do that and this door is yours."

quest_warriorsguild_000.title: Defeat the Ogre Lieutenant
quest_warriorsguild_000.summary: The Warrior's Guild takes no one who has not put down the Ogre Lieutenant.
quest_warriorsguild_000.nextStep: The Ogre Lair is in the southwest of the Forest. Follow the path out of town north, then head west when you reach the Forest.
quest_warriorsguild_000.reminderDialog: "The Ogre Lieutenant is still breathing. His lair is southwest in the Forest. Come back when that's no longer true."
quest_warriorsguild_000.completionDialog: "Then you're one of us." The recruiter hauls two blades off the display rack — a bastard sword and a great sword — and hands them over. "Signing bonus. The guild's skills and its quests are open to you now."

quest_warriorpete_intro.title: Talk to Warrior Pete
quest_warriorpete_intro.summary: Now that you're in the guild, one of its warriors would like a word. He is not impressed.
quest_warriorpete_intro.objective: Talk to Warrior Pete at the Warrior's Guild.
quest_warriorpete_intro.nextStep: Pete stands with the other guild warriors outside the hall (Room 226), northwest of the Grand Square.
quest_warriorpete_intro.reminderDialog: You haven't spoken to Warrior Pete yet. He's outside the guild hall with the rest of them.
quest_warriorpete_intro.completionDialog: Pete looks over from the weapon rack. "You say you're a warrior, huh? I don't see it." He counts three things off on his fingers. "Prove me wrong."

quest_warriorpete_001.title: Banish the Skeleton Knights
quest_warriorpete_001.summary: Skeleton Knights hold the Catacombs beneath Red Town. Pete wants three of them put back down.
quest_warriorpete_001.nextStep: The Catacombs run west off the sewers. Head down into the sewers and northwest to the great stone wall, then search it for the door.
quest_warriorpete_001.reminderDialog: "{progress} of {count}. They're in the Catacombs under town — through the sewers, northwest, past the stone door."
quest_warriorpete_001.completionDialog: "Three back to hell." Pete tosses you a pair of knuckles carved out of something that used to walk. "Bone Knuckles. Suits you."

quest_warriorpete_002.title: Shark Hunter
quest_warriorpete_002.summary: Sharks infest the water below the Blue Ocean. Pete is holding two of the best swords in the guild for whoever hunts them.
quest_warriorpete_002.objective: Defeat a Great White and a Hammerhead.
quest_warriorpete_002.nextStep: The Blue Ocean lies west of the Grassy Field. Get beneath it with a Gills Potion or a Gills spell — both sharks are down there.
quest_warriorpete_002.reminderDialog: "Still dry, I see. A Great White and a Hammerhead, both under the Blue Ocean. You'll need gills to get to them."
quest_warriorpete_002.completionDialog: "Both of them." Pete brings out two swords he's clearly been sitting on for a while. "Great White Sword and the Hammerhead Hammer. Best steel in the building."

quest_warriorpete_003.title: True Troll Champion
quest_warriorpete_003.summary: The Troll Champion is one of the strongest beasts in the Dark Forest. Pete wants three of them.
quest_warriorpete_003.nextStep: Troll Champions hold the Dark Forest, north of the regular Forest.
quest_warriorpete_003.reminderDialog: "{progress} of {count} Champions. They're in the Dark Forest, north of the regular one. Take your time — or don't, and see how that goes."
quest_warriorpete_003.completionDialog: "Three Champions." Pete drags a suit of reforged plate out from under a bench. "Made from the last lot. Wear it with some pride."

quest_wizardsguild_intro.title: Talk to the Wizard's Guild Recruiter
quest_wizardsguild_intro.summary: Robed men and women mingle outside the Wizard's Guild, talking magic and potions. One of them is watching you.
quest_wizardsguild_intro.objective: Talk to the Wizard's Guild Recruiter.
quest_wizardsguild_intro.nextStep: The Wizard's Guild (Room 225) is southeast of the Grand Square.
quest_wizardsguild_intro.reminderDialog: You haven't spoken to the Wizard's Guild Recruiter yet. The guild is southeast of the Grand Square.
quest_wizardsguild_intro.completionDialog: The recruiter's attention settles on you all at once. "Defeat the evil Kobold Master — at all costs. Then we can talk about what else you might learn here."

quest_wizardsguild_000.title: Defeat the Kobold Master
quest_wizardsguild_000.summary: The Wizard's Guild takes no one who has not put down the Kobold Master.
quest_wizardsguild_000.nextStep: The Kobold Lair is in the northwest of the Forest. Follow the path out of town all the way north, then southwest when the path runs out.
quest_wizardsguild_000.reminderDialog: "The Kobold Master still holds his chambers. Northwest of the Forest. Magic will serve you better than steel down there."
quest_wizardsguild_000.completionDialog: "Then you are one of us." The recruiter hands you a staff and a pointed hat with no ceremony whatsoever. "Signing bonus. The guild's spells and its quests are open to you."

quest_wizardmorty_intro.title: Talk to Wizard Morty
quest_wizardmorty_intro.summary: Now that you're in the guild, one of its wizards has some opinions about your abilities.
quest_wizardmorty_intro.objective: Talk to Wizard Morty at the Wizard's Guild.
quest_wizardmorty_intro.nextStep: Morty is among the robed crowd outside the guild (Room 225), southeast of the Grand Square.
quest_wizardmorty_intro.reminderDialog: You haven't spoken to Wizard Morty yet. He's outside the guild with the rest of them.
quest_wizardmorty_intro.completionDialog: "So you think you're a powerful wizard, huh." Morty does not look up from whatever he is stirring. "Three things. Then we'll see."

quest_wizardmorty_001.title: Rare Gray Matter
quest_wizardmorty_001.summary: Morty needs a piece of gray matter. Only rare creatures carry it.
quest_wizardmorty_001.objective: Bring 1 Gray Matter to Wizard Morty.
quest_wizardmorty_001.nextStep: Gray matter comes off rare enemies — the named dead in the Catacombs carry it, and so do the rarer things you'll meet as you travel.
quest_wizardmorty_001.reminderDialog: "No gray matter yet? Rare creatures drop it. Keep travelling and something unusual will cross your path eventually."
quest_wizardmorty_001.completionDialog: Morty takes the lump, turns it over twice and does something to it you do not follow at all. What he hands back is a wand. "Gray Wand. Try not to point it at anything you like."

quest_wizardmorty_002.title: Omar & Victoria the Dead
quest_wizardmorty_002.summary: Two named dead keep the deepest rooms of the Catacombs. Morty wants them both gone.
quest_wizardmorty_002.objective: Defeat Omar the Dead and Victoria the Dead.
quest_wizardmorty_002.nextStep: Both are deep in the Catacombs below Red Town — Victoria keeps the Sacred Altar, Omar the Sacrificial Chamber. Omar hits like a falling headstone; Victoria attacks with magic, so your MAG is what stands between you and her.
quest_wizardmorty_002.reminderDialog: "Still standing, are they. Victoria keeps the altar, Omar the chamber below it. Mind her casting — steel won't help you there."
quest_wizardmorty_002.completionDialog: "Both of them. Quietly, too." Morty passes you a pair of boots that are not entirely leather. "Bone Boots. They were hers, before."

quest_wizardmorty_003.title: Magic and the Troll Queen
quest_wizardmorty_003.summary: The Troll Queen holds the deep Dark Forest, and she is not the sort of thing you hit.
quest_wizardmorty_003.nextStep: Her nest is deep in the Dark Forest, far to the north. She fights with magic and shrugs off ordinary weapons — bring spells.
quest_wizardmorty_003.reminderDialog: "The Troll Queen still holds her nest. Far north, deep in the Dark Forest. Use magic on her. I cannot stress that enough."
quest_wizardmorty_003.completionDialog: "You actually did it." Morty produces a staff that is far too heavy for him to be holding so casually. "Solomon Staff. It'll cost you some strength to carry — worth every point."

quest_miningguild_intro.title: Talk to the Mining Guild Recruiter
quest_miningguild_intro.summary: The forge at the back of the Dwarf Village never stops, and one of the miners standing outside it is not there to work.
quest_miningguild_intro.objective: Talk to the Mining Guild Recruiter.
quest_miningguild_intro.nextStep: The Mining Guild (Room 308) is east of the Dwarf Village Square, which is northeast of the Rocky Flats Crossroads.
quest_miningguild_intro.reminderDialog: You have not spoken to the Mining Guild Recruiter yet. The guild hall is east of the village square.
quest_miningguild_intro.completionDialog: He looks you over the way a man looks over a tool. “Our members do more than swing a pick. Prove you can do something about Red Beard and the Neverending Mine is yours.”

quest_miningguild_000.title: Red Beard the Traitor
quest_miningguild_000.summary: Captain Red Beard turned on the dwarven guard and took the Red Fort with him. The Mining Guild will not take anyone who has not dealt with him.
quest_miningguild_000.nextStep: The Red Fort is west of the grass path south of the Crossroads. Courtyard, hallway, barracks, then north into the war room.
quest_miningguild_000.reminderDialog: “Red Beard is still breathing and still in that fort. West across the grass, then keep going west.”
quest_miningguild_000.completionDialog: “Then you’re one of us.” He hands over a bundle of picks and one good iron one. “The mine is open. Mind the rock, mind the things in it, and bring the guild something back.”

quest_guildleader_intro.title: Talk to the Mining Guild Leader
quest_guildleader_intro.summary: The Guild Leader holds the far end of the hall and demonstrates perfect mining form at anyone who stands still long enough.
quest_guildleader_intro.objective: Talk to the Mining Guild Leader.
quest_guildleader_intro.nextStep: He is at the back of the Mining Guild hall (Room 308), same room as the recruiter.
quest_guildleader_intro.reminderDialog: The Guild Leader is still waiting at the back of the hall.
quest_guildleader_intro.completionDialog: “Three things live down there that shouldn’t. Deal with them and I’ll teach you what to do with what you dig up.”

quest_miningguild_001.title: Iron Boss: The Phoenix
quest_miningguild_001.summary: Something is circling at Mine Level 10 and it never comes down. Kill it and the guild will teach you to work iron.
quest_miningguild_001.objective: Defeat the Phoenix at Mine Level 10.
quest_miningguild_001.nextStep: Dig down from the mine head. The Phoenix flies — melee cannot reach it, so bring a bow or a crossbow and the ammunition for it.
quest_miningguild_001.reminderDialog: “The Phoenix is still up there. And you still can’t hit it with a sword, before you ask again.”
quest_miningguild_001.completionDialog: “Good. Iron’s yours.” He pushes a hammer across the bench. “Any forge fire will do — ours is the best of them, but Red Town’s will serve.”

quest_miningguild_002.title: Steel Boss: The Cyclops
quest_miningguild_002.summary: A cyclops has taken Mine Level 20, which is also where the coal is. The guild would like both back.
quest_miningguild_002.objective: Defeat the Cyclops at Mine Level 20.
quest_miningguild_002.nextStep: Mine Level 20. Do not count on your armour — its attacks are pure, so your DEF never enters the arithmetic.
quest_miningguild_002.reminderDialog: “Still down there, is it. Your shield won’t help. Bring more health than you think you need.”
quest_miningguild_002.completionDialog: “Steel next, then.” He hands you a steel hammer and a pick to match. “Coal and iron make steel. You’ll work the rest out.”

quest_miningguild_003.title: Mithril Boss: The Minotaur
quest_miningguild_003.summary: The bottom of the Neverending Mine, as far as anyone has dug, and there is something standing on it.
quest_miningguild_003.objective: Defeat the Minotaur at Mine Level 30.
quest_miningguild_003.nextStep: Mine Level 30. It is strong, it is fast, and when it goes into a rage nothing you are wearing matters.
quest_miningguild_003.reminderDialog: “Mine Level 30. It has been down there longer than the guild has been up here. Go carefully.”
quest_miningguild_003.completionDialog: The whole hall goes quiet for a moment. “Mithril,” says the Guild Leader, and hands you the hammer for it. “Nobody has brought that back before.”

quest_dwarfcaptain_intro.title: Talk to the Dwarf Captain
quest_dwarfcaptain_intro.summary: The Dwarven Captain keeps the law for the whole of the Rocky Flats from a post in the middle of the Crossroads, and he is short-handed.
quest_dwarfcaptain_intro.nextStep: The Rocky Flats Crossroads (Room 303) is the hub of the map — northwest of the stone path in from Red Town.
quest_dwarfcaptain_intro.reminderDialog: The Dwarf Captain is still standing his post at the Crossroads.
quest_dwarfcaptain_intro.completionDialog: “The Rocky Flats is full of danger,” he says, in the tone of a man who has said it a great many times. “Three things need doing. Pick one.”

quest_dwarfcaptain_001.title: Clear out the Abandoned Mine
quest_dwarfcaptain_001.summary: The condemned mine west of the Crossroads has been overrun by three things that were not there when it was condemned.
quest_dwarfcaptain_001.objective: Defeat a Rabid Skeever, a Bleeding Dartwing and a Mongolian Death Worm.
quest_dwarfcaptain_001.nextStep: The Abandoned Mine is northeast off the muddy path west of the Crossroads. Down the shaft, then southwest, west, northeast — one of them in each room.
quest_dwarfcaptain_001.reminderDialog: “{progress} of {count}. Skeevers on the tracks, dartwings in the nests, and the worm at the far end. All three.”
quest_dwarfcaptain_001.completionDialog: “That’s the mine, then.” The Captain hands you a heavy gold key. “There’s a chest in the Treasury north of here that this opens. Consider it settled.”

quest_dwarfcaptain_002.title: Glowing Sea Monster
quest_dwarfcaptain_002.summary: A glowing monster has been reported under the sea, and the Captain wants it confirmed by someone who came back.
quest_dwarfcaptain_002.objective: Find and defeat the Glowing Octopus.
quest_dwarfcaptain_002.nextStep: Under the Blue Ocean, a long way down. You will want gills before you go looking.
quest_dwarfcaptain_002.reminderDialog: “Still nobody has seen it up close and come back to say so.”
quest_dwarfcaptain_002.completionDialog: “So it is real.” The Captain unwraps a bow with a charge laid into the limbs, and two heavy quivers with it. “You’ll want the reach out there.”

quest_dwarfcaptain_003.title: Missing Dwarf Axeman
quest_dwarfcaptain_003.summary: A dwarven guard has gone missing. He was last seen on patrol around the Stone Grotto and has not reported in since.
quest_dwarfcaptain_003.objective: Find the missing axeman at the Stone Grotto.
quest_dwarfcaptain_003.nextStep: The Stone Grotto is behind a carved stone door southwest of the grass path. A switch in the Red Fort Kitchen opens it.
quest_dwarfcaptain_003.reminderDialog: “No word yet. The Grotto is where he was headed — if you can get the door open.”
quest_dwarfcaptain_003.completionDialog: “You found him.” The Captain looks genuinely relieved for about a second. “Whatever had hold of him has let go. He owes you, and dwarves are unbearable about owing people.”

quest_bountyboard_intro.title: Read the Dwarf Guard Bounty Board
quest_bountyboard_intro.summary: A board of wanted posters stands beside the coal fire in the village square, built by the Dwarven Guard and kept unpleasantly up to date.
quest_bountyboard_intro.nextStep: The Bounty Board is in the Dwarf Village Square (Room 307), by the fire.
quest_bountyboard_intro.reminderDialog: You have not read the Bounty Board yet. It is beside the fire in the village square.
quest_bountyboard_intro.completionDialog: Three postings, in three hands, none of them recent. The rewards at the bottom of each are not small.

quest_bountyboard_001.title: Grunt Bounty
quest_bountyboard_001.summary: Vicious things roam the roads, the forests and the dungeons, and the Guard pays by the head. Ten of each of six kinds.
quest_bountyboard_001.objective: Defeat 10 each of Goblins, Ogres, Kobolds, Skeletons, Bandits and Trolls.
quest_bountyboard_001.nextStep: Anywhere. Goblins and ogres in the Forest and its lairs, kobolds under it, skeletons in the Catacombs, bandits in the Red Fort and Red Town’s alleys, trolls in the north of the Forest.
quest_bountyboard_001.reminderDialog: “The posting is still up. Ten each — goblins, ogres, kobolds, skeletons, bandits, trolls. Every kind counts, not just the big ones.”
quest_bountyboard_001.completionDialog: The Guard tallies your count twice, then hands over a very large axe and a very heavy purse. “The roads are quieter. That was the point.”

quest_bountyboard_002.title: B-Squad Bounty
quest_bountyboard_002.summary: Three second-rate bosses with first-rate opinions of themselves. The Guard would like them dealt with before they get ideas.
quest_bountyboard_002.objective: Defeat the Hill Ogre, the Scorpion Queen and the Butcher.
quest_bountyboard_002.nextStep: The Hill Ogre holds the outcrop behind the hill in the Forest. The Scorpion Queen is deep in the Scorpion Pit under the Grassy Field. The Butcher runs the Red Fort Kitchen.
quest_bountyboard_002.reminderDialog: “{progress} of {count}. Hill Ogre, Scorpion Queen, Butcher. None of them are hiding.”
quest_bountyboard_002.completionDialog: “B-Squad,” says the Guard, with feeling, and hands you a staff crowned with a scorpion’s tail. “They were somewhat impressive. Somewhat.”

quest_bountyboard_003.title: Elite Bounty
quest_bountyboard_003.summary: The last posting, and the oldest. Three things nobody has managed to collect on.
quest_bountyboard_003.objective: Defeat King Squid, the Stone Sphinx and the Gatekeeper.
quest_bountyboard_003.nextStep: King Squid is under the Blue Ocean, the Stone Sphinx sits in the mountain pass, and the Gatekeeper holds the gate of the Dark Keep.
quest_bountyboard_003.reminderDialog: “{progress} of {count}. That posting has been up a long time. It will keep.”
quest_bountyboard_003.completionDialog: The Guard reads your count, reads it again, and takes a gilded falchion down off the wall behind the board. “That one has been hanging there since before I took this post.”
